nodes.label: Render-time injection of mileage, terms and Bonzah clauses into stored agreement templates
Rationale: inject at render time instead of rewriting the operator's stored template row
Rationale: injection is conditional on the tenant's own configuration, so no clause is forced on anyone
Rationale: splice above the EARLIEST signature marker in the document, not the first pattern that matches
Rationale: splice at the enclosing block start or the PDF block parser emits literal BLOCK_18 markers
Rationale: legacy vehicle_allowed_mileage placeholder check stops the allowance being stated twice
Three byte-identical copies of the injector: portal, booking, Deno edge function
Canonical mileage allowance and excess-rate resolution for rental agreements
Billing-tier resolution for mileage (daily/weekly/monthly)
Rationale: unconfigured mileage renders 'Not specified', never 'Unlimited' — printing Unlimited would contractually grant it
Rationale: tier selection also requires that tier's rate to exist, mirroring pricing, or the agreement states a tier the renter was not billed
Rationale: excess mileage rate is a money term in a signed contract — use tenant currency_code and distance_unit
Three byte-identical copies of the mileage resolver across portal, booking and edge functions
Tenant CMS Terms and Conditions incorporated into the rental agreement
Rationale: deliberately not filtering cms_pages.status='published' — every section save resets it to draft, which silently dropped terms
Rationale: append tenant terms to the built-in boilerplate rather than replacing it, which would drop insurance/liability/governing-law clauses
Rationale: skip presentational metadata keys so a title-only CMS section yields an empty terms block
Defence-in-depth sanitisation of operator-authored CMS markup before embedding it in a contract
Rationale: terms are additive — a CMS hiccup must never block an agreement from being sent
Rationale: a CMS section hidden from the website must not appear in the customer's contract
Automation trigger event registry (Spec 7.1)
Rationale: registry is hand-mirrored with the edge-function copy for V1; a JSON source of truth is deferred until it drifts
Lead lifecycle stage machine (new to converted/lost/blacklisted)
Phase gating: only phase-1 events are emitted and offered as automation triggers
Automation step grammar: sms, email, wait, condition, stop
Bonzah-required insurance addendum clauses inside the signed rental agreement
Rationale: insurer-supplied compliance text is a code constant, not tenant-editable CMS content, so operators cannot alter it
Rationale: the addendum is a tenant-level referral disclosure, not a purchase receipt — gated on integration_bonzah alone
Rationale: ASCII-only punctuation because one renderer strips non-Latin-1 chars, turning curly quotes into gaps
Rationale: flat h2/p sequence with no wrapper div — the portal HTML-to-PDF block parser does not treat div as a block
Bonzah renter-facing insurance disclosure text, links and coverage flyers
Rationale: link the insurer's canonical flyer URLs instead of self-hosted mirrors that go stale on revision
Rationale: business partner terms are operator-facing and must never appear in the renter disclosure
Consumer Terms of Service points at business.bonzah.com, superseding the URL still hyperlinked in the source document
Bonzah policies cannot start today — coverage windows clamp to Pacific tomorrow
Incident: a GoNiko same-day +1 extension charged 26.95 USD with no policy behind it
Rationale: calendar arithmetic on Pacific date parts, not now+24h, because fixed milliseconds drift on the DST fall-back day
Bonzah sell-side gating: staff cannot sell a policy while the tenant is in test mode
Rationale: sandbox Bonzah policies are not real cover while stripe_mode stays independent, so the customer pays real money for nothing
Rationale: gate selling only — viewing, downloading, retrying and cancelling existing policies must work in every mode
bonzah_sandbox_override: super-admin escape hatch for internal/demo tenants
Tenant booking-site URL resolution across dev ports and production subdomains
Apply and offer deep links from the portal into the customer booking app
Client-side dark-mode brand colour derivation for the portal Branding settings UI
Auto-derived versus hand-picked dark colour detection (clobber protection)
Rationale: after an operator edits the light colour, the base-colour comparison is the only remaining evidence the dark value was machine-generated
Rationale: the base arm counts only when the derivation actually transformed the value, else identity derivations clobber hand-picked colours
Rationale: lightenForDark is not idempotent (19% of the RGB cube drifts) — never re-derive from an existing dark value
Rationale: secondary is deliberately not lightened, matching buildTenantPalette — fixing it would break sync for every existing tenant
Portal duplicates the edge-function colour maths because it cannot import Deno code — change both together
Booking site renders dark mode and reads the dark_* columns, so a light-only edit is a silent no-op for customers
Extension pricing with weekend/holiday surcharges, always on daily-tier iteration
Rental extras total: per_trip flat charge versus per_day multiplication
Rationale: billing_type (how often) is orthogonal to pricing_type (where the unit price comes from)
Dynamic rental pricing: tier selection plus per-day weekend/holiday surcharges
Byte-identical duplication convention: booking and portal lib copies must diff clean or customer and staff prices disagree
Per-day-equivalent tier rate preserves weekly/monthly discounts while only special days carry the surcharge
Turo-style per-day manual price overrides the tier rate and every surcharge for that calendar day
Additive surcharge stacking mode (weekend plus each holiday) versus default highest-priority-wins
Rationale: auto-extend 'set price' rentals skip surcharges and manual prices so the advertised flat rate holds
Rationale: Postgres numeric arrives as a JSON string over PostgREST — coerce with Number() or the total corrupts via string concatenation
Safari-safe YYYY-MM-DD parsing for pricing date maths
Fleet availability timeline: every vehicle gets a row, idle cars included
Tenant-wide availability blocks (vehicle_id null) attach to every vehicle row
Per-day pricing strip classification so calendar surcharge markers match what booking charges
Open-ended (PAYG) rentals draw a bar extending past the visible window
Display-only CDW+RCLI bundle merge for Bonzah coverage chips
Platform credit pricing and per-service credit costs (e-sign, Twilio message, licence verification)
Client-side insurance policy CSV export
Date-only column parsing that avoids the UTC-midnight off-by-one
Rationale: new Date('YYYY-MM-DD') parses as UTC midnight and renders the previous calendar day in negative-UTC zones
